verdict.root_cause: Every failing PlaceOrder trace aborts at the same point: checkoutservice's outbound CartService/GetCart call is the deepest span and the only non-inherited ERROR (tr_39d61a838631). Failures return sub-millisecond, so this is immediate rejection at the cart hop, not slow-dependency waiting. checkoutservice is exonerated as origin (clean internal span; no change records, tr_382063006eb4), other checkout downstreams are never reached or are flat-zero healthy (tr_88f35ed09b48). cartservice emitted no span-metric series at all - neither error numerator nor call denominator (tr_1a4680ab07c2) - consistent with a process not serving RPCs. What made cartservice stop serving was never established: no cart-side changes, logs, or pod state were queried before the metrics budget ran out. A crashlooping wrong image, an OOM/restart loop, and a bad listen address or credential all produce this identical signature at the depth reached.
verdict.reasoning: Localisation to the checkout->cart hop is strong: the trace evidence shows a uniform signature with ERROR originating at the GetCart leaf and propagating upward, and rules out timeout dynamics, checkout-internal faults, frontend origin, and other downstreams (tr_39d61a838631). checkoutservice has no change to roll back (tr_382063006eb4), and productcatalogservice is affirmatively healthy (tr_88f35ed09b48). cartservice's absent denominator (tr_1a4680ab07c2) corroborates a cart not answering calls rather than a healthy cart - the corpus shows that same silence being misread as health. But the mechanism is unnamed: bad_deploy, resource_exhaustion and bad_config all yield fast rejections plus silent telemetry, and distinguishing them needs cart change history, logs or restart state, none of which were dispatched. Choosing a class now would be importing the corpus's prior wrong-image incidents as an answer.
open_questions: What is cartservice's actual process state - crashlooping, OOMKilled, or up but rejecting? No cart logs, pod status or restart counts were collected.
Is there any change record on cartservice near onset? Only checkoutservice's log was queried, and it covered 15 minutes rather than the requested 90.
Why is checkoutservice's error ratio bursty (0 to 0.67, tr_28f9f06549f8) while every sampled trace fails uniformly - restart loop or sampling artefact?
